author: wittjosiah
principle: Setting an object's parent pointer must be backed by an actual reference from the parent to the child (in the data model or an annotation); do not set a bare parent pointer with nothing on the parent side referencing it.
fix_shape: add a ref or annotation on the parent side alongside the parent-edge write, or enforce it as an invariant in the setter

author: wittjosiah
principle: Do not add child objects that the parent holds no reference to; a parent-child relation must be backed by a ref (or a replacing annotation), not just a computed edge.
fix_shape: give the parent an explicit ref/annotation for each child it is meant to own

author: wittjosiah
principle: An internal invariant-checking predicate that only an API's own implementation needs must not be declared on the public object API.
fix_shape: make the helper an internal implementation detail of the function that uses it, not a public export

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Look up an object's referrers through the reverse-reference index rather than scanning every object in the space.
fix_shape: replace the full-space scan with the indexed reverse-reference query

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When introducing a new on-disk or wire format, add a test that migrates data created under the old format rather than only exercising the new format on fresh data.
fix_shape: add a test that creates state in the old format and transparently migrates it to the new one

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the domain-specific branded type for a field (e.g. an AutomergeUrl type) instead of a bare string.
fix_shape: change the field's declared type to the specific domain type

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Place tool configuration files (e.g. a dedicated tsconfig) under the repo's shared config directory rather than at the repo root.
fix_shape: move the config file into the conventional config subdirectory

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A plugin should receive environment/platform information from the framework that hosts it rather than each plugin statically declaring its own platform-specific module.
fix_shape: have the host framework pass platform as a parameter/capability instead of a per-plugin static export

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not keep a production code path alive only because tests use it; question whether test-only scaffolding needs to live in the main module.
fix_shape: remove the code path or move it into test-only helpers if nothing else needs it

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Remove an indirection layer once a more direct mechanism supersedes it; do not leave the old and new mechanisms both in place.
fix_shape: delete the superseded entrypoint/indirection once the newer mechanism covers its job

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Before writing bespoke scanning/build logic, check whether an existing tool already has an option to do the same job.
fix_shape: use the existing tool's built-in option instead of adding new custom logic

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Give tests proper resource isolation (e.g. separate processes) when one test's resource usage can affect a later one, rather than marking the flaky test as reporting-only.
fix_shape: isolate the test's resource usage (separate worker/process) instead of suppressing the failure

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Keep related state owned by the single component responsible for its lifecycle rather than spreading it across separate wrapper collections.
fix_shape: hold the collection directly on the owning class instead of a separate registry object

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Consolidate related per-entity bookkeeping (maps, subscriptions, cleanup) into the single class that owns entity lifecycle rather than scattering it across sibling maps.
fix_shape: move the bookkeeping fields and their handling into the owning manager class

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not extract trivial test-setup snippets into helper functions that hide the official API under test; keep test bodies calling the real API directly for readability.
fix_shape: inline the helper's body so the test shows the actual API usage

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Document explicitly what an automatic-update mechanism does NOT guarantee, not only what it does, when the two could be conflated.
fix_shape: add a doc line stating the non-guarantee alongside the behavior description

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not expose a raw underlying resource handle through a public wrapper API; proxy only the methods callers need so they cannot accidentally retain the raw handle beyond its managed lifetime.
fix_shape: hide the raw handle and expose a proxy limited to the safe methods

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not wrap a call in an external cancellation/context helper when the callee itself already accepts a context and can handle cancellation internally.
fix_shape: move the cancellation handling into the function that owns the context instead of wrapping every caller

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not add a separate lookup method when an existing method's contract already covers returning the existing instance; extend or reuse it instead.
fix_shape: fold the new behavior into the existing method's options rather than adding a parallel method

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Expose state that UI needs to observe reactively as a reactive atom/signal, not a one-shot Effect or promise-returning getter.
fix_shape: back the accessor with an Atom instead of a plain Effect call

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Avoid asserting on an exact boundary value in a test when a less precise value exercises the same behavior more robustly.
fix_shape: advance/assert past the boundary by a safe margin instead of the exact edge value
